arguments.sql:
SELECT c.mcc, c.description, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id
JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc
WHERE c.description = 'Passenger Railways'
GROUP BY c.mcc, c.description
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.mcc
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each MCC code described as 'Passenger Railways', one row per code, largest count first.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, whether or not they have a fraud label.
Transactions are linked to MCC through merchants.mcc, since transactions has no mcc column.
